enabled.description: Whether holding the modifier over an element shows the inspector. The command peek.toggle switches the current documents only.

modifier.description: The key held while hovering. Held alone, none is a reserved combination; Ctrl+Alt (AltGr) is not offered. Takes effect in documents loaded after the change.

syncHighlight.description: Outline the inspected element in every other view as well.

showBoxModel.description: Draw margin, border, padding and content of the inspected element.
